dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, sharply defined outer perimeters with a rapid gradient transition to lighter interior regions; these are most distinct in the upper-central dorsal and mid-posterior sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and dispersed throughout the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three major annuli in the mid-dorsal region, connecting to an irregular quadrilateral formed by clusters in the posterior-dorsal section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, prominent, high-intensity linear white vertical mark is located on the ventral-lateral surface near the mid-posterior section of the body.
